canonical_statement: For every Type-valued presheaf F on a category C, F is representable if and only if there are an object X and an element x of F(op X) such that, for every Y, the function sending f : Y -> X to F.map f.op x is bijective.

conclusion: The universal-element criterion is logically equivalent to F.IsRepresentable.
